idea-plugin.name: JSONSpy - Enterprise JSON & Schema Workbench
idea-plugin.description:
JSONSpy - Enterprise JSON & Schema Workbench

A high-performance enterprise JSON editing, validation, transformation, and visual schema modeling workbench inspired by Altova XMLSpy.

Key Features:

  • Monaco JSON Editor & SmartFix: Enterprise syntax highlighting, folding, and one-click automatic syntax repair for corrupted JSON payloads.
  • Ajv Schema Engine: Real-time Draft 2020-12 and Draft-07 JSON Schema validation with inline violation highlights.
  • Visual React Flow Schema Designer: Interactive node-graph editor for inspecting, editing, and inferring JSON schema definitions.
  • JSONata Transformation Engine: Real-time query execution, data mapping, and numeric aggregation.
  • Multi-Format Code Generator: One-click TypeScript, Rust, Kotlin, Go, Python, and C# type definition generator.
  • In-Process Local Server & JCEF Bridge: Zero-latency IDE file operations via native loopback bridge.

Keyboard Shortcuts:

  • Ctrl+O / Cmd+O: Open JSON File
  • Ctrl+S / Cmd+S: Save File
  • Ctrl+Shift+F / Cmd+Shift+F: Prettify JSON
  • Ctrl+Enter / Cmd+Enter: Run JSONata Query
idea-plugin.change-notes:
JSONSpy v1.0.0 Release Notes

  • Multi-Platform Release: Initial release supporting Tauri v2 Desktop, Web SPA, and IntelliJ Platform IDEs.
  • Out-of-Process JCEF Support: Native Chromium webview embedding for IntelliJ 2026.2+ (`262+`) with automatic module classloader resolution.
  • SmartFix Syntax Recovery: One-click repair for trailing commas, unquoted keys, and single-quoted strings.
  • Ajv Validation & Schema Inference: Real-time Draft 2020-12 schema validation and automatic schema inference.
  • Interactive Tree Grid & React Flow Canvas: Dual-mode interactive JSON manipulation and visual node graph editing.
